entries.note: Trump landed in Manila 17:33 on 17 Nov and Daily Tribune reports he attended the ASEAN-US Special Summit with Marcos and regional leaders that night (Inquirer/Newswav piece of 20:48 PHT confirms it was convened that evening); exact clock time not seen but published 01:30 PHT 18 Nov as already held.
ČTK reported only a rough T-Mobile estimate of 'over 100,000' (similar to last year) and no explicit organiser figure was found, so whether the first organiser figure reached 110,000 is not settled.
Kahana was elected Speaker on 17 Nov with 66 votes (opponent Ophir Katz 52), one short of 67.
